identity_lock.silhouette: Rounded navy beret, subdued ash-beige bob, compact navy A-line dress, thin tan strap, compact satchel and its single small rabbit remain unmistakable in every frame.
identity_lock.proportions: Frame 0 is authoritative: preserve its broad rounded head and face width, rounded jaw, approximately four-head-tall compact torso, short sturdy thighs and calves, sock cylinders, shoe size, fixed body height and planted-foot spacing exactly.
identity_lock.face_and_markings: Pale rounded face, muted blue-gray eyes, fixed fringe and matte cool ash-beige hair; only the gaze, eyelids, a tiny thinking mouth and a restrained head tilt may change.
identity_lock.costume: Cream collar, orange ribbon, approved brass-button layout, full loose sleeves, lace hem, cream socks, black Mary Jane shoes, tan strap, compact satchel and small rabbit keep their exact topology and scale.
identity_lock.rendering: Soft polished miniature anime sprite with fine dark outlines, restrained warm cel shading, subdued original hair highlights, fixed orthographic camera and neutral light.

action_contract.intent: She releases the strap, folds her left forearm across her waist to support her right elbow, rests the right knuckles lightly under her chin, silently tests a hypothesis with a small gaze shift, reaches a restrained conclusion, then unfolds and regrips the strap.
action_contract.contact_key: The left forearm is crossing above the waist and beginning to cradle the right elbow while the right hand approaches the chin; the head remains nearly upright.
action_contract.reasoning_key: The left arm securely supports the right elbow, the right knuckles and index finger lightly support the chin and cheek, the head tilts only a few degrees, and the eyes look diagonally upward in concentrated thought.
action_contract.conclusion_key: The chin lifts a fraction from the knuckles, the index finger shifts slightly along the cheek, and the eyes refocus with a quiet deduction rather than a smile or theatrical reaction.
action_contract.locked_elements: Shoes, feet spacing, root, body scale, hat, hair identity, collar, ribbon, buttons, strap route, satchel identity, rabbit identity and camera remain fixed.
action_contract.allowed_motion: Both arms and hands, a head tilt no greater than five degrees, eyelids and gaze, a tiny mouth change, very small shoulder and hem response, and minimal satchel or rabbit secondary sway.
action_contract.forbidden_changes: No sitting, crouching, stepping, large lean, tapping the temple, crossed legs, eyeglasses, notebook, hologram, formula, light bulb, effects, body slimming, brightened hair, enlarged rabbit, opened bag, extra anatomy, scenery, shadow, text or watermark.

key_pose_sources.strategy: Generate every key and later every transition as a separate complete full-character drawing from the canonical identity anchor and approved temporal neighbors. Never construct motion by moving, blending or warping image parts.

threshold_notes.min_alpha_coverage: The corrected crossed-arm pose folds both sleeves inside the torso silhouette, reducing visible alpha coverage without shrinking any locked body landmark. A separate proportion-report gate enforces head, face, eye, skirt and leg ratios against F00.
threshold_notes.max_area_drift: Crossed forearms widen the upper torso silhouette while the character height and root remain fixed.
threshold_notes.max_bbox_aspect_drift: The supported-elbow thinking pose changes sleeve overlap without changing body proportions.
threshold_notes.max_center_range_px: The asymmetric chin-rest gesture permits a small horizontal centroid shift while both feet remain locked.

post_process.generation: Every motion frame is a separate complete-character built-in image-generation call using the canonical anchor and temporal neighbors.
post_process.forbidden: No cut-and-paste parts, local compositing, translated layers, optical flow, cross-fade, morphing or algorithmic interpolation.
post_process.background_removal: Use a flat #FF00FF source background, explicit magenta chroma removal, soft edge matte and despill.
post_process.final_downsample: Uniformly normalize complete drawings into a fixed 512x512 cell, preserving body scale, shoe center and the y=472 visible baseline.

frames.pose: gaze lowers and strap hand loosens
right hand leaves the strap and left elbow begins folding
left forearm crosses the waist as right hand rises
support arm reaches the elbow and right fingers approach the chin
knuckles contact the chin and shoulders settle
head tilts into the supported hand and eyes track upward
deep reasoning pose with elbow supported and chin lightly cradled
eyes shift subtly while index finger adjusts on the cheek
quiet deduction with a fractional chin lift and refocused gaze
right hand leaves the chin while the elbow remains supported
both arms begin unfolding across the torso
left hand lowers and right hand returns toward the strap
strap is regripped and head returns to center
